unit_portion:
A standing claim in the issue tracker held that the process records why it chose each answer but never why it chose each question. The rationale for the question choice turned out to be recorded, and recorded thoroughly — 2596 of 2598 choices carry an authored reason, every one of 1022 deferrals carries a reason, and a further verdict is present on 486 of 515 records. None of it was reachable from any place that would read it, so at every such place the rich record and no record at all looked identical.

The rationale lives in files written to a directory excluded from version control — zero of them tracked — so a fresh copy of the repository contains none of it. The files carry no stamp of their own origin: no record of which model, prompt, or schema produced them, and no timestamp of their own. And there is no link from the items they explain back to them: the field on each item that would carry the producing run's identifier holds the literal string for absent in all 71 live emissions, and the one variable in the orchestration code that holds the path of the file just written is assigned in two places and read in none. Nothing consumes the deferral list at all except two audit probes, one of them an archived copy. Each of the three gaps is individually mild — an untracked output directory, an unstamped file, an unpopulated optional field — and together they make the record unaddressable, so a reader at any downstream point sees the same thing whether the rationale was never written or is sitting on a machine they do not have. What was actually wrong was therefore the opposite of the standing claim: not that the choice went undeclared, but that its declaration could not be gotten to.

A recon that treated an earlier agent's summary as hypothesis and re-witnessed every load-bearing claim with pasted output and a positive control beside it: a census script written for this audit rather than reusing the earlier counts, a tracked-and-non-empty sibling directory as the control for the untracked one, an exhaustive rather than sampled classification of both shortfall strata, and a planted two-sided fixture proving the classifier could emit the other verdict — which is what makes the zero in that stratum a measured zero rather than a branch that never fires. The re-witnessing changed several of the earlier numbers, and the writeup states which figures supersede which.

A characterization of the system's own discipline had stood in the tracker and was false as written; it was corrected explicitly rather than quietly amended. The fix is a join identifier minted at choice time and threaded through all three write paths — the third of which was found only while implementing — plus a self-stamp on each file, a tracked location, and a standing readout with a four-way token that names which of the failure states obtains. The readout is declared wired but not yet joined: all 205 live items still report no identifier authored, and the joined state is exercised only by a planted control, so the fix graduates on the next real run rather than now.
payload:
You will read one description of a software failure and assign it exactly one category.

Here are the five categories, plus a sixth for incidents that fit none of them. All six are equally
available answers. Each category is given in its original wording followed by an English rendering.

A — 环境/平台 Quirk  (environment / platform quirk)
逻辑正确，运行环境隐含行为导致失效（dev 绿灯，target 暴露）。
系统逻辑正确，但运行环境（OS / shell / 客户端 / 文件系统）的隐含行为导致意外。
*The logic is correct, but implicit behaviour of the runtime environment — operating system, shell,
client, filesystem — causes it to fail. Characteristically: the development environment is always
green, and only running on the real target exposes it.*

B — 设计假设错配  (design-assumption mismatch)
代码假设 vs 实际（部署拓扑 / 契约 / 测试形态 / 涌现行为）。
代码基于某个假设，但假设与实际不一致。
*The code rests on an assumption — about deployment topology, a cross-component contract, the shape
of test input, or emergent behaviour — and the assumption does not match reality. Characteristically:
unit tests covering the logic correctly is not the same as covering the real caller's actual form.*

C — 错误吞噬与稀释  (error swallowing and dilution)
错误发生但被某层静默吃掉 / 跨层稀释失 cause / 自动批量放大。
错误真实发生了，但被某一层静默吃掉，或跨层传递时上游 cause 被稀释，最终用户视角看到的是"成功"或
一个失去信息的告警。
*The error really happened, but some layer silently ate it, or the upstream cause was diluted while
being passed across layers, so what the end user finally sees is "success" or an alert that has lost
its information.*

D — 链式幻觉与编造  (chained hallucination and fabrication)
把污染数据当事实，编造合理叙事推送给用户（最危险）。
错误不是消失，而是被加工成看起来正常的内容。链路中每一跳都会放大幻觉，前一跳的幻觉会被下游当作
事实执行。
*Corrupted data or polluted context is taken as fact and worked up into a plausible narrative that
is pushed to the user. The error does not disappear — it is processed into content that looks
normal. Each hop amplifies it, and one hop's fabrication is executed downstream as fact.*

E — 运维遗漏与取证盲区  (operational omission and forensic blind spot)
代码正确但部署/注册步骤遗漏 / 调试工具自身被屏蔽长潜伏。
两个子机制：(1) 运维遗漏 — 代码正确但部署/注册/配置步骤被漏（声明态 ≠ 运行时态）；
(2) 取证盲区 — 调试工具自身被屏蔽返回空内容，被误读为"正常"，导致超长潜伏。
*Two sub-mechanisms: (1) operational omission — the code is correct but a deployment, registration
or configuration step was missed, so declared state is not runtime state; (2) forensic blind spot —
the debugging tool is itself blocked and returns empty content, which is misread as "normal",
producing an extremely long latency before discovery.*

other — 机制不属于以上任何一类。
*The incident's mechanism is not one of the five above. This is a substantive answer, not a
leftover. Choose it whenever the mechanism described is genuinely a different kind of thing,
including when the description is too thin to identify a mechanism at all.*
